tenderSchedule.description: Supply of man power (Stenographer-1no, Computer Operator-1no, Driver 1 no, Office Attender 2no) To Spice Board Hubballi

tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
All terms and conditions as per tender document.

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Agency should have an minimum of 3 years experienced in the required field and experience certificate of Last three years should be attached

To supply Human resource to Government or Government Organizations, the tenderer should be registered with Labour Department. In this view, Valid Certificate has to be attached with technical bid compulsorily
Copy of the duly attested GST certificate
Copy of the duly attested PAN card
Copy of the E.P.F. Code number obtained from EPF Department
Copy of the ESI code number obtained from ESI Department
Income Tax Returns filed statement of last 3 year to be submitted (2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26).
The Agency should have an minimum of Rs.15.00 lakhs turn over in last one year. (CA Audited report should be attached)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Audited CA Certificate of Annual Turnover
